verdict.rationale: Managed OAuth for downstream tools with encrypted credential vaulting is a fair question for an agent framework and platform like Mastra, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions running OAuth flows, storing credentials encrypted, or refreshing tokens automatically. Its storage, memory, MCP and webhook features are unrelated to credential management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh
